title: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise
notes: A technique id is ATT&CK-T<NNNN> with an optional .<NNN> sub-technique (REQ-DET-002). Only the shape and the technique-number band are pinned: the ledger's ATT&CK figure counts what a check names, and the purple replay catalogue (templates/purple/attck-map.yaml) remains the only other place a technique appears. A short id such as ATT&CK-T123 is refused.
